To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the choice of the appropriate inflection and postpositional word in Bengali depends on the spelling of the translated noun and on the WordNet sense information of the head nouns, respectively.
(i) the choice of inflection depends on (a) the spelling pattern of Bengali head noun, and (b) the WordNet synsets; and (ii) postpositional words depend on the WordNet information.
the translation of English prepositions to Bengali is based on the spelling pattern and postpositional word of the translated Bengal head noun.
In summary, our research is concerned with
handling prepositions in an MT system from English to a language like Bengali.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the prepositions of English are not translated into Bengali as such, but rather the lexical meaning of a preposition is translated into a Bengali noun phrase.
the handling of prepositions in English to Bangla machine translation has been done in a way that is consistent with the way the native speakers of Bangla handle the same prepositions.
the translation of English prepositions to Bengali is a challenging problem, but it can be solved by a combination of lexical and syntactic knowledge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the handling of prepositions in English to Indo-Aryan MT systems is a complex issue, and a simple rule-based system may not be adequate to handle it.
the handling of English prepositions in English-Bengali MT is a complex task and requires a combination of different techniques.
the lexical meanings of English prepositions are mapped onto Bengali postpositional words, which are attached to the head nouns of the prepositions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

preposition handling can be done in a systematic manner, and that a prepositional phrase can be translated into Bengali in a single pass, without the need to identify the thematic role of the preposited noun.
the choice of the appropriate inflection depends on both the spelling pattern of translated Bengali head nouns and WordNet synset.
the lexical meanings of the prepositions are preserved in the target Bengali translation.
